# clavis rotation create

<p class="cli-lead">Create a rotation policy</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis rotation create KEY [flags]
```

</div>

Create a rotation policy for a key.

## Examples

<p class="cli-example-title">Postgres role password, daily</p>

```sh
clavis rotation create DATABASE_PASSWORD --provider postgres \
  --pg-host db.internal --pg-database app --pg-username admin \
  --pg-password "$PGPASSWORD" --pg-role app_user --interval 24h
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Your own webhook, monthly</p>

```sh
clavis rotation create PARTNER_API_KEY --provider webhook \
  --webhook-url https://rotate.example.com/partner --webhook-secret "$HMAC_SECRET" \
  --interval 720h
```

## Details

Providers: `postgres` (role password), `aws` (IAM access key; the secret
stores JSON with `access_key_id` and `secret_access_key`), and `webhook`
(`create`, `rollback` and `revoke` calls, HMAC-signed).
